name: web
description: Web-app workflow on Vue 3 + TypeScript: the enforced style rules and a style-only pass with a reference Biome config (style), done-time review with the API contract (review), per-unit Vitest coverage (cover), TSDoc and comment fixing (doc), per-route Playwright coverage (e2e), UX improvement committed one ranked fix at a time with before/after pictures (improve), and performance fixes measured under a 4x CPU slowdown, front end and back end, without changing what the user sees (perf).
